meaning: A page listed here was read by the named reviewer, who found no story relation to extract as a claim (for example an index page, a design interview or a duplicate). It is NOT an owner approval, NOT a certification and NOT a statement that the page has no lore value. It is reversible: delete the entry, or cite the page from a claim pack (the coverage builder rejects a page that is both cited and listed).

reasons.INDEX_OR_LANDING_PAGE: a collection, index, hub or e-book landing page that links to or lists story content without telling it
reasons.DESIGN_OR_PROCESS_ARTICLE: a behind-the-scenes, design or interview article about making a set; it describes creative process, not in-world events
reasons.DUPLICATE_PAGE: a second URL for a page whose text is already cited; duplicate_of names the cited URL
reasons.PRODUCT_OR_PROMO_NOTE: a product, preorder or promotional note with no in-world narrative
reasons.NO_EXTRACTABLE_RELATION: in-world text, but no sentence states a relation between named entities clearly enough to quote (use sparingly; note says why)

entries.note: Card-gallery hub for previews ('We'll collect those story moments right here'); its body is section headings plus an ebook preorder line, with no narrative text in the cached page.
